newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases, market mixed.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases, market mixed.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally on Friday in a mixed market where prices on average held at very low levels, brokers said.
The index shed 9.96 points to close at 3392.25. Turnover was posted at 72.475 million shillings on 868,228 shares compared to 26.961 million shillings on 412,466 shares on Thursday.
Oil firm Total Kenya was the biggest decline, maintaining a downward trend seen the whole week. The share lost three shillings to close at 59.50.
"There was a lot of selling pressure from investors disappointed by year-end results and most buyers were not willing to come up on the price," a bourse official said.
Other key shares in a downward posture were Uchumi Supermarket which closed at 38.25 from 40 and Diamond Trust Bank Kenya at 30.75 from 32.
Lonrho Motors gained 39 to close at 164.

"Lonrho is the hot cake in the market right now," a senior broker said, adding that a bonus issue of two shares for every one share held and a final dividend of eight shillings had boosted demand for the share.
Kenya Commercial Bank adjusted after a loss of 4.0 seen on Thursday, to close at 97 from 93. Brokers had said the drop was temporary and not a reaction to year-end results released on Wednesday.
Barclays Bank traded at 120 on the one-hour hold special board, while Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 120.
Standard Chartered Bank closed at 46.25 from 46.50 while Kenya Airways eased to 8.50 from 8.60.
